subject: GRB 260806A: CALET Gamma-Ray Burst Monitor detection
submitter: Yuta Kawakubo at Aoyama Gakuin University <kawakubo@phys.aoyama.ac.jp>
body:
S. Ricciarini (U of Florence), A. Yoshida, T. Sakamoto, S. Sugita, 
Y. Kawakubo (AGU), K. Yamaoka (Nagoya U), S. Nakahira (JAXA), 
Y. Asaoka (ICRR), S. Torii, Y. Akaike, K. Kobayashi (Waseda U), Y. Shimizu,
T. Tamura (Kanagawa U), N. Cannady (GSFC), M. L. Cherry (LSU), 
P. S. Marrocchesi (U of Siena),
and the CALET collaboration:

The CALET Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (CGBM) detected GRB 260806A
at 07:26:59.65 UTC on 6 August 2026 (trigger #1470036404;
https://cgbm.calet.jp/cgbm_trigger/flight/1470036404/index.html).
A CGBM Notice was distributed in near real time.

This event was also reported by Glowbug (Cheung et al., GCN #45348).

The burst signal was seen by all CGBM detectors.
The burst light curve shows a multi-peaked structure starting
at T+1.7 s, peaking at T+6.9 s, and ending at T+64.6 s.
The T90 and T50 durations measured with the SGM data are 55.7 +/- 3.1 s
and 34.9 +/- 11.5 s in the 40-1000 keV band, respectively.

The ground-processed light curve is available at:
https://cgbm.calet.jp/cgbm_trigger/ground/1470036404/

The CALET data used in this analysis were provided by
the Waseda CALET Operation Center located at Waseda University.
